title: Grants subsystem (new) has no explicit test; four catalog validation rejections unreached
detail: Grants (new) land via run.odin and emit Ev_Stock_Arrived; the happy path is transitively pinned by the surge_basics T1 golden (inventory + event stream both hashed). No test feeds a malformed grants catalog, so the four validation rejections are unreached.
recommended_fix: Add a catalog_test loading balance bytes with non-ascending grant at_tick (plus unknown-tier and non-junction router grant entries) asserting the fail-fast rejections; optionally pin Ev_Stock_Arrived deltas in a run_test.
